definitions.explanation: In Christianity, the third person of the Trinity, together with the Father and the Son. A central concept in Christian theology.

examples.japanese: {聖霊|せいれい}の{導|みちび}きを{信|しん}じる。
examples.english: To believe in the guidance of the Holy Spirit.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}と{子|こ}と{聖霊|せいれい}の{御名|みな}によって。
examples.english: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

examples.japanese: {聖霊|せいれい}{降臨|こうりん}はキリスト{教|きょう}の{重要|じゅうよう}な{出来事|できごと}とされている。
examples.english: The descent of the Holy Spirit is considered an important event in Christianity.

notes:
USAGE:
A Christian theological term. Part of the Trinity ({三位一体|さんみいったい}): {父|ちち} (Father), {子|こ} (Son), and {聖霊|せいれい} (Holy Spirit). {聖霊|せいれい}{降臨|こうりん} refers to the Day of Pentecost.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聖霊|せいれい}の{働|はたら}き (the work of the Holy Spirit)
- {聖霊|せいれい}{降臨|こうりん} (descent of the Holy Spirit; Pentecost)
- {聖霊|せいれい}を{受|う}ける (to receive the Holy Spirit)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {精霊|せいれい}: spirit, soul of the deceased — a homophone with a different meaning; refers to spirits of the dead or nature spirits
